description: The owner's team (2026-11-16). Si's battle skill only when her button shows it (Artful Intent isn't up), no Initial Stroke (2026-11-17: Haste is movement speed only, the game's glossary and the logs); her Artful Intent then runs its full 20 s and bursts by itself (the owner: ending it early wastes SP). Spare SP (200) goes to Akekuri's battle skill. Ultimates when ready; combos when lit; Estella's battle skill after Arcane's combo. 56,423 sustained DPS over 300 s at a 0.3 s reaction delay (10 seeds, sd 2,039), against 55,462 (sd 2,929) for the earlier list that ended Artful Intent early at every 100 SP (the old delay draws; with common random numbers, 2026-11-16: 57,096, sd 1,402). With the fixed driver (2026-11-16; 32 fresh seeds, 1001–1032): 56,493 (sd 1,913), from zero 56,055 (sd 1,309). After the engine changes of 2026-11-16 (bosses freeze, Haste not on attacks, teammates' pause) and without Initial Stroke (2026-11-17): 53,781 (sd 1,194), from zero 52,740 (sd 1,539), same seeds.
